summary: Mandatory post-critical-security regression completed against the external origin: 32/32 API tests passed across core, follow-up, edge and new security suites. Browser visitor/student registration submissions, Arabic calendar, KRC correction, older purchase lookup, receipt reject/replace/approve/unlock, metadata-to-private-file viewer, paginated library, profile saving and navigation passed. Previous application findings resolved; no unresolved flow/API failures found. Only test files changed.
action_items: Main agent may generate the actual private owner invitation after this verified cleanup.

success_rate.frontend: All executed critical workflows passed after correcting test-only selectors/navigation expectations

test_credentials: Credential file confirmed no existing active credentials. Isolated generated accounts used; all removed and private manifest deleted. Only delivered@resend.dev used for actual existing-account reset mail. No actual owner invite created or consumed.
seed_data_creation: Removed eight test users, sixteen courses, nineteen purchases (including sixteen synthetic later history rows), seven file metadata rows, two lectures, one retained category, twenty-three sessions and two separately tagged test invitations. Settings restored exactly. Managed objects lack a provider delete API; metadata removed and access blocked. Rate-limit buckets left to expire.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run core -> follow-up -> edge -> security -> browser -> cleanup, each pytest module separately (max 16 tests/run). New security library test retains fourteen API-created free courses for browser testing. Do not rerun library setup into retained state without cleanup. Follow-up/security suites skip if manifest absent. Browser helper accepts environment-derived base and isolated state; extracted from executed Playwright flows, syntax checked, not separately executed as a combined module. Calendar days use buttons filtered by exact visible day text because day-picker assigns gridcell roles; default caption title is correctly clipped via rdp-vhidden, not duplicated visually. Logout redirects to login and preserved location.state.from can send an admin to /dashboard; tests explicitly navigate to /admin after successful login. No application code modified. No integration MOCKED.
security_verification: External cookies retain Secure, HttpOnly, Path=/api; infrastructure rewrites application SameSite=Lax to None+Partitioned. This is an understood constraint, not a failed application fix. Authenticated mutation without X-Kura-Request:1 returned 403, hostile Origin even with header returned 403, hostile preflight returned 400 with no allow-origin, legitimate same-origin preflight/login succeeded, and unauthenticated no-cookie login without custom header succeeded. Actual UI authenticated mutations passed with axios header.
storage_and_permissions: Malformed signature-only PDF now returns 422; genuine PIL-generated PDF uploads and streams through real storage. Private metadata excludes storage path/owner and matches file permission denials for anonymous, unrelated member and employee. Normal, suffix and open-ended ranges returned matching bytes/206; invalid/out-of-range/multi-range returned 416. Download code reviewed: 8MB spool threshold present. Large-video concurrency/load performance not exercised.
mail_verification: Managed send_reset_email accepted a real test message. Public forgot-password against an isolated existing account temporarily using delivered@resend.dev returned neutral success and retained its reset token, confirming provider did not report delivery failure. Inbox receipt/link clicking not inspected; expired/single-use/session invalidation reset tests used isolated inserted tokens, not mocked provider responses.
browser_verification: Submitted unique visitor and KRC student registrations through mobile UI and verified dashboard plus /auth/me values. Direct YYYY-MM-DD typing, Arabic calendar day/month/year selection, non-native picker and no duplicate visible caption verified. Admin KRC correction saved, reflected in approved student's profile, and remained disabled for that student; API uniqueness test passed. Course detail immediately showed existing awaiting_receipt purchase hidden behind sixteen newer rows without Buy. Real receipt upload, reasoned rejection, replacement, approval and course unlock passed; viewer fetched authorized metadata then actual private text file (200 each). Dashboard counted fifteen accessible courses; library displayed twelve then three, search and category filters worked, mobile pagination had no document overflow. Mobile profile save persisted. Desktop public navigation and non-clickable future research/posts spans had no overflow. No visible app errors or broken relevant images observed.
rca of the issue: No unresolved application issue reproduced. Initial browser harness interruptions were a day-picker role mismatch and incorrect logout/admin landing expectations; corrected using exact button text and explicit post-login workspace navigation. Previously reported PDF parser, category audit/404, exact lookup, KRC editor and date picker fixes all passed regression. Proxy cookie rewriting is compensated by validated custom-header, strict-Origin and CORS controls.
